lines.text: Moses says the LORD goes across the Jordan ahead of Israel as a consuming fire against strong, tall nations.
Moses says the LORD drives out the nations because of their wickedness, not Israel's righteousness, since Israel is stiff-necked.
Moses stayed on the mountain seven days and seven nights, then received tablets inscribed by the finger of God.
Moses came down, saw the molten calf, shattered the tablets, then burned the calf and ground it to dust.
The LORD told Moses to chisel new tablets and make an ark, and Moses kept the tablets in his tent.

wrong_details.wrong: kept the tablets in his tent
wrong_details.true: placed the tablets in the ark he had made
